one_line: A question in text and voice, one station per voiceover line, ending on one save ask.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 wide pan over a sunny gan yard with small tables and signs. Voiceover (transcript): the same question as the text, built word by word: "איך נראית יום הולדת כשאמא היא מטפלת באמנות?".
q1_hook.why: A specific question with an odd answer to see, said and written together from 0:00 (H5, H6, H4), over a bright, unusual yard (H1). The first image is a wide, empty setup with no child or product, and the text sits low in the frame (against H2, T4).

beats.what: A wide pan of the party yard; the headline builds word by word with the voice
beats.why: A question that makes the viewer want to see

beats.what: Station signs and set tables: face painting, watercolours, bracelets, clay popsicles; voice: "פסטיבל יצירה"
beats.why: Shows the concept before the details

beats.what: Top-down flat lay of face paints, oil pastels, watercolours, markers, pipe cleaners and clay
Fan painting with watercolours; bracelets with pipe cleaners and beads; a letterboxed clip of a child threading
beats.why: Stations 1 and 2, one per voiceover line

beats.what: Clay popsicles: sign, bowls of clay, a clay box
Free drawing: markers and oil pastels held up, then scribbles
beats.why: Station 4, with a child's marks as proof

beats.what: The face-paint sign and two face-paint kits held to the lens
Children's hands thread beads, paint fans, model clay; subtitles from 0:38
Children draw with markers and a yellow oil pastel; "תשמרו את הסרטון לחגיגה הבאה שלכם !"
beats.why: The ask lands on a busy, colourful shot

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: Voice and subtitle at 0:42-0:45: "תשמרו את הסרטון לחגיגה הבאה שלכם !". Caption: "שמרו את הפוסט לחגיגה הבאה שלכם". No question to answer.
q2_flow.why: Five stations, each one voiceover line and one sign, give a clear numbered structure with a new picture about every 2 s (R3, E2, K2). The children using the supplies come only in the last third, after a long product-led list (R3). At 46 s it is long for the content (R2).

q3_cta.what: Spoken (transcript) and subtitled 0:42-0:45: "תשמרו את הסרטון לחגיגה הבאה שלכם !". Caption, fifth line: "שמרו את הפוסט לחגיגה הבאה שלכם 🥳".
q3_cta.why: One action, repeated in voice, text and caption, after the stations are shown (C1, C6). A save ask fits a list of ideas worth returning to (R7), though sends matter more and no recipient is named (C4). It is plain, with no bait.

q4_shown.what: The yard and station signs 0:00-0:08; a top-down flat lay of supplies 0:09-0:12; each station's table, some packs held to the lens, 0:12-0:32; children's hands using them 0:19-0:20 and 0:33-0:45. No price, no creator face.
q4_shown.why: The credential in the first line and a real party give weight (S6). Each station shows the exact products, so a parent can copy it (R7, K4). Brand packs and logos fill the flat lay and held-up shots for much of the Reel, and children using them appear late (C7, H3, S4).

q5_edit.what: About 24 shots in 46 s (first-pass count, about 1.9 s each), cuts keyed to the voiceover's list; handheld and static mixed; one letterboxed clip at 0:19-0:20. Voiceover throughout. Text only as the headline 0:00-0:03 and subtitles 0:38-0:45. Ends on children drawing.
q5_edit.why: Cuts keyed to the voiceover's list change the picture about every 2 s with a clear structure (E2, R3). The voice carries the content with only 11 s subtitled, so a muted viewer relies on the signs in the scene (E4, T1). The letterboxed clip breaks the full-screen look (F1).

q6_topic.what: A children's birthday built as five creative stations, by a mother who is an art therapist; it serves parents planning a party who want a different, creative concept.
q6_topic.why: A dated, high-intent moment, a coming birthday, with a ready-to-copy list (K7, R7), told as a mother's own story with a professional credential (K6, S6). The mood is festive but mild (K1).

q7_filmed.what: Handheld wide pans of a kindergarten yard in bright sun; top-down flat lays on a blue table cloth; hands holding packs to the lens; top-down and side shots of children's hands working, faces mostly cropped; one letterboxed clip.
q7_filmed.why: Daylight and a real party yard look homemade and vivid (H8, F7). Flat lays and held-up packs fill the frame, so logos and colours read (F4, F5). Children appear mostly as hands and cropped faces (S5), but the letterboxed clip and mixed shot types feel uneven (F1).

q8_text.on_screen: 0:00-0:03 large white outlined headline building word by word with the voice, three lines, about 62 to 79 percent down: "איך נראית יום הולדת כשאמא היא מטפלת באמנות?". Handwritten station signs in the scene, such as "עמדת איפור פנים" and "הכנת צמידי כוח". 0:38-0:41 subtitle "אז אם גם אתם מתכננים יום הולדת עם ערך והמון יצירה"; 0:42-0:45 "תשמרו את הסרטון לחגיגה הבאה שלכם !".
q8_text.caption: "מתכננים יום הולדת בקרוב?". 35 words in 6 short lines: two questions, the concept "פסטיבל יצירה", "5 תחנות יצירה צבעוניות", a save ask, then "בשיתוף ממומן @giotto_israel". No hashtags.
q8_text.why: The headline is spoken and built word by word with the voice (T3, H6), but it sits low (T4), and the 34 s after it have no subtitles for the voiceover (T1). The caption opens with an audience question and the concept (T7); the disclosure is in words but in the last line (T8).

weak_points: Brand packs and logos fill much of the Reel; 34 s of voiceover with no subtitles; a letterboxed clip; no price or where to buy; an empty-yard first image; the disclosure only in the caption's last line.
lumebook_takeaway: Film a "five ideas" walk-through with one sign or label per idea and one voiceover line each, then close with one save ask on screen.
not_verified: Whether the party was the creator's own (the voiceover says it was her daughter's); the clay and bead brands; the letterboxed clip's origin; music (the voiceover runs throughout). The birthday child's name is on a sign and is not written here. Correction: the headline runs 0:00-0:03; the first subtitle appears at 0:38 and the save-ask subtitle at 0:42-0:45.
